parameters.name: NameSpaceShortId
parameters.description: The short-format ID of the namespace. You do not need to specify the region. We recommend that you use this parameter.

parameters.name: NamespaceId
parameters.description: The long-format ID of the namespace. If you specify this parameter, NameSpaceShortId is ignored. This parameter is for backward compatibility. We recommend that you use the short-format namespace ID.
